2.5.2 Of the total 37,170 Murder cases reported in the country, the 23 cities together recorded 2,747 such cases comprising 7.4 per cent of the national share. Incidence wise, Delhi reported the highest (514) sharing 18.7 per cent amongst all cities followed by Mumbai (340). Kochi city recorded significant increase of 69.2 per cent Murder cases over previous year as against decline of 3.7 percent at national level.

2.5.3 The total reported cases of Attempt to Commit Murder in the 23 cities were 2,868 as against 3,035 cases in 1998 reporting a decline of 5.5 percent in cities compared to national level decline of 3.1 percent. The percentage share of these in the national share was 9.7.

2.5.4 The share of C.H. not amounting to murder cases at All-India level from 23 cities decreased marginally from 5.5 per cent to 5.2 per cent. Delhi City alone recorded 61 cases sharing 30.2% of all-cities under this category of crime.
